code.binding.database.graph.why: Store property graph data and answer Cypher queries inside its own process without a database server.
code.binding.database.graph.how: Provides Database, Connection and QueryResult types with typed Value parameters and rows.

code.binding.database.graph.why: Load large row sets into the graph and read neighbourhoods back without one statement per row.
code.binding.database.graph.how: Offers COPY from files, Arrow table registration and Arrow or CSR result batches under the arrow feature.

code.binding.database.graph.why: Place partitions of a partitioned node table on other hosts while the engine stays unaware of distribution.
code.binding.database.graph.how: Installs process-global callbacks for placement, partition lifecycle and row insertion through RoutingGuard.

code.engine.database.graph.why: Call the C++ engine from safe Rust for database, connection, statement, query and value operations.
code.engine.database.graph.how: Declares a cxx bridge of C++ functions in lbug_rs.cpp and lbug_rs.h that wrap engine classes and return results or exceptions.

upstream.library.ffi.why: Generate the Rust and C++ glue for the bridge and translate C++ exceptions.
upstream.library.ffi.how: The cxx::bridge macro and cxx::Exception type.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Reuse the connection, query result and prepared statement types of the main bridge.
code.bridge.ffi.how: Aliases the main bridge types inside a second cxx bridge compiled only with the arrow feature.

upstream.library.data.columnar.why: Exchange tables and result chunks as Arrow arrays and schemas without copying through Value rows.
upstream.library.data.columnar.how: ArrowArray and ArrowSchema wrappers are declared as trivial extern types over the Arrow C data interface.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Convert between the Rust column type enum and the engine LogicalType.
code.bridge.ffi.how: From conversions to and from the bridge LogicalType and LogicalTypeID, including list, array, map, struct, union and decimal parameters.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Decode engine values into Rust values and encode Rust values as query parameters.
code.bridge.ffi.how: TryFrom of the bridge Value into Value and TryInto of Value into the bridge Value; also NodeVal, RelVal and InternalID graph value types.

code.type.logical.why: Report and build the column type of each value.

upstream.library.datatype.why: Represent dates, timestamps, UUIDs, decimals and JSON in common Rust types.
upstream.library.datatype.how: Maps engine values to time, uuid, rust_decimal and serde_json types, and returns a ConversionError when a value is out of range.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Carry engine failures to the caller as one Rust error type.
code.bridge.ffi.how: From cxx::Exception wraps C++ exceptions; query and prepare failure messages become FailedQuery and FailedPreparedStatement.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Open an on-disk or in-memory database with a SystemConfig of buffer pool size, thread count, compression, read-only mode, size cap, checkpointing, checksums and multi-write.
code.bridge.ffi.how: Database::new and Database::in_memory call the bridge database constructor with the config values.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Keep a planned query so repeated executions skip planning.
code.bridge.ffi.how: Wraps the bridge prepared statement and exposes is_read_only and, with the arrow feature, get_arrow_schema.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Read rows, column names, column types, row count and timings from an engine result.
code.bridge.ffi.how: Iterator over Vec<Value> rows plus a Display that prints a table, and a to-CSV option set (CSVOptions).

code.codec.value.why: Return each cell as a typed Rust value.
code.codec.value.how: The iterator decodes each engine tuple into Vec<Value>.

code.type.logical.why: Describe column types of the result.

code.bridge.ffi.arrow.why: Read results in bulk as Arrow record batches and CSR index arrays.
code.bridge.ffi.arrow.how: iter_arrow returns an ArrowIterator and csr returns CsrResult (indptr, indices, optional edge ids), both under the arrow feature.

code.handle.database.why: Attach a session to an open database; the connection borrows the database for its lifetime.
code.handle.database.how: Connection::new takes &Database and keeps its lifetime parameter.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Send Cypher text to the engine and control the session.
code.bridge.ffi.how: query, prepare, execute, interrupt, set_query_timeout and per-connection thread count call bridge functions; connections are Send and Sync because the C++ side synchronizes them.

code.statement.prepared.why: Run a parameterized query many times.
code.statement.prepared.how: prepare returns a PreparedStatement; execute binds a list of named Value parameters to it.

code.codec.value.why: Bind Rust values as named query parameters.
code.codec.value.how: execute converts each Value to the bridge Value before the call.

code.result.query.why: Return the output of a query to the caller.

code.bridge.ffi.arrow.why: Register in-memory Arrow data as node or relationship tables and run queries with the native Arrow collector.
code.bridge.ffi.arrow.how: create_arrow_table, create_arrow_rel_table, create_arrow_rel_table_csr, drop_arrow_table and query_as_arrow, under the arrow feature.

code.type.error.how: Every method returns Result with Error.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Register process-global hooks with the engine before any Database opens.
code.bridge.ffi.how: A C ABI shim in lbug_partition_routing.cpp and include/lbug_partition_routing.h turns the engine C++ hooks into plain function pointers; callbacks run on any query thread.

code.codec.value.why: Hand inserted rows to the wrapper as decoded values.
code.codec.value.how: insert_row receives (PartitionRef, Vec<Value>) in parent schema order.

code.type.logical.why: Describe the parent table scan schema so claimed partitions read back.
code.type.logical.how: register_parent_schema maps scalar LogicalType values to engine type ids and rejects non-scalar types.

code.type.error.how: Returns FailedQuery for double install, empty schema, NUL bytes and non-scalar types.

upstream.repository.release.why: Fetch a prebuilt static or shared liblbug archive and headers for the host platform.
upstream.repository.release.how: Wraps download-liblbug.sh, fetched from the ladybug repository if missing, and writes .cache/lbug-prebuilt.env; a PowerShell twin serves Windows.

code.script.download.why: Obtain a prebuilt engine archive before compiling anything.
code.script.download.how: try_download_prebuilt_lbug runs the download script, caches the archive in OUT_DIR or LBUG_PREBUILT_CACHE_DIR, and falls back to source on failure.

code.engine.database.graph.why: Link the engine statically or dynamically, or compile the bundled source when no archive is usable.
code.engine.database.graph.how: Chooses among external LBUG_LIBRARY_DIR and LBUG_INCLUDE_DIR, the prebuilt archive, or a CMake build of lbug-src; optionally localizes bundled C symbols; adds -rdynamic for extensions.

upstream.toolchain.build.why: Compile the engine source and the C++ shims.
upstream.toolchain.build.how: Drives cmake and the cxx build for src/ffi.rs, the routing shim and, with the arrow feature, src/ffi/arrow.rs.

upstream.library.tls.why: Resolve the search path for libssl and libcrypto that the engine links.
upstream.library.tls.how: link_openssl checks OPENSSL_DIR, vcpkg, pkg-config and standard directories.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Compile the bridge and routing shim against the engine headers.
code.bridge.ffi.how: build_ffi generates the cxx glue for src/ffi.rs and compiles lbug_rs.cpp and lbug_partition_routing.cpp.

code.bridge.ffi.arrow.why: Compile the Arrow bridge when the arrow feature is on.
code.bridge.ffi.arrow.how: A second build_ffi call for src/ffi/arrow.rs and lbug_arrow.cpp.

code.handle.database.why: Let the caller open a database.

code.handle.connection.why: Let the caller run Cypher against a database.

code.result.query.how: Re-exports QueryResult, CSVOptions and, with the arrow feature, ArrowIterator and CsrResult.

code.codec.value.why: Exchange typed values with the caller.
code.codec.value.how: Re-exports Value, NodeVal, RelVal and InternalID.

code.router.partition.why: Let a distributed wrapper take over partition placement.

code.script.build.why: Get a linked engine and compiled bridges at build time.
code.script.build.how: Cargo runs build.rs; lib.rs documents LBUG_* environment variables and exposes VERSION, LBUG_LIBRARY_SOURCE and get_storage_version.

code.router.partition.why: Install placement, lifecycle and insert callbacks and register parent schemas.

code.bridge.ffi.why: Send Cypher text to the engine and control the session, including parameterized reuse.
code.bridge.ffi.how: query, interrupt, set_query_timeout and per-connection thread count call bridge functions; prepare returns a PreparedStatement (a planned query with is_read_only and, under the arrow feature, get_arrow_schema) and execute binds named Value parameters to it; connections are Send and Sync because the C++ side synchronizes them.
